answer: Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The tide decay curve is applied at each close, falcon records the drop, and vine recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. The attacker spends 32 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
